ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels localized to the perimeter and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white central zone spanning both lobes. Black border pixels form a continuous band along the trailing edge and outer tips. Irregular brownish-orange pixel clusters are concentrated near the median notch and the central-right fluke region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel amplitude along the entire trailing edge. Notable jagged indentation on the distal right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves on the leading edges tapering to acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular grey pixel clusters, approximately 5-8 distinct points, distributed across the mid-section of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical orange-brown linear disruption on the right lobe; several faint, unaligned grey linear scratches on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant vertical orange-pigmented scar on the right lobe; irregular jagged tissue loss on the far right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Widespread brownish-yellow pigmentation or bio-fouling patterns concentrated around the fluke base and trailing edge center.
